\section*{Architectural fixes during formalization}

\paragraph{IrrSkeleton refactor.}
The \texttt{def:Ghat} definition originally bundled
\texttt{UnitaryRep.IrreducibleClass} as ``the type of equivalence
classes of finite-dim irreducibles''.  In Lean, this was a structure
\emph{without} a quotient: two distinct
\texttt{ξ₁, ξ₂ : IrreducibleClass G} could have
\texttt{ξ₁.rep ≅ ξ₂.rep} and yet be distinct as elements, which
violated \texttt{IsHilbertSum}'s requirement that distinct indices
give orthogonal subspaces.  We added a separate
\texttt{UnitaryRep.IrrSkeleton G := Quotient (IrreducibleClass.setoid G)}
type and re-indexed the Hilbert-sum statements over
\texttt{IrrSkeleton G}.  See the implementation note in
\texttt{def:Ghat}.

\paragraph{Universe correction in \texttt{matrixCoeffSet}.}
\texttt{UnitaryRep.matrixCoeffSet G} originally quantified over
\texttt{V : Type} (i.e.\ \texttt{Type 0}), but the down-stream
applications need \texttt{V : Type u} where $u$ is $G$'s universe (the
isotypic indexing type carries a field at $G$'s universe).  Fixed in
Chapter~7's Lean file; no blueprint change.

\paragraph{Two external assumptions.}
\begin{itemize}
  \item \textbf{Compact self-adjoint spectral theorem}
    (\texttt{ass:spectral}, Chapter~5): the bundled form (countable
    family of real eigenvalues with FD eigenspaces and dense span) is
    not in Mathlib; Mathlib has the constituent pieces in
    \texttt{Analysis/InnerProductSpace/Spectrum.lean} but not the
    combined statement.  Treated as an external assumption.
  \item \textbf{Schauder's theorem} ($T^\dagger$ compact when $T$ is):
    not in Mathlib at any name we could find.  Treated as the second
    external assumption (it is not directly cited from
    \texttt{content\_comp.tex}; it is internal to the Lean Schur proof).
\end{itemize}
